ulthera-prime.name: Ulthera Prime
ulthera-prime.tagline: Lifting that elevates from the root, reaching the SMAS with ultrasound
ulthera-prime.intro:
Precision 1:1 premium lifting,
guided by real-time ultrasound
imaging of the skin layers

features.title: Ultrasound Imaging Guidance
features.body: Visualizes skin layers in real-time during the procedure, accurately targeting the dermis and SMAS layers.

features.title: Fundamental Layer Stimulation
features.body: Stimulates the SMAS layer, which is lifted in surgical procedures, non-invasively to create a natural lifting effect.

features.title: Collagen Regeneration Induction
features.body: The ultrasound coagulation points gradually reconstruct collagen over time, with results completing over 2 to 3 months post-treatment.

features.title: One-Time Treatment
features.body: Results can be expected from a single session, making it suitable for those with limited time.

ulthera-prime.howItWorks: High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) forms coagulation points at depths of 1.5mm (dermis), 3.0mm (deep dermis), and 4.5mm (SMAS) without damaging the skin surface. These coagulation points stimulate the natural healing process, producing new collagen and elastin, thereby tightening the skin from within.
recommendedFor: Those concerned about sagging jawlines and V-lines
Individuals with deep nasolabial folds and wrinkles
People whose faces appear sagging due to decreased elasticity
Those seeking fundamental lifting without surgery
Individuals wanting to see changes from a single treatment

faq.q: How long does the treatment take?
faq.a: It varies depending on the area and number of shots, but typically takes about 30 to 60 minutes.
Pain is alleviated with a numbing cream, and there may be slight tingling during deeper treatments. The level of discomfort varies by individual.
You may feel immediate firmness right after the treatment, but the full effects from collagen regeneration will gradually appear over 2 to 3 months.
Most patients can return to their daily activities immediately after the treatment, and any slight swelling typically subsides naturally within 1 to 3 days.

ulthera-prime.introBody: This treatment precisely stimulates the SMAS layer (the deepest fascia of the skin) with ultrasound to induce collagen regeneration. As the next-generation model of the Ulthera, a leading HIFU device approved by the FDA, the procedure is conducted while monitoring the treatment area and depth in real-time.

thermage-flx.name: Thermage FLX
thermage-flx.tagline: A 4th generation lifting treatment that enhances skin texture and elasticity with radiofrequency.
thermage-flx.intro:
Premium firming lift that delivers
radiofrequency energy deep into the skin
to stimulate collagen renewal

features.title: Monopolar Radiofrequency
features.body: Delivers RF energy uniformly from the skin surface to the entire dermis, rearranging collagen.

features.title: AccuREP Automatic Adjustment
features.body: Real-time measurement of skin impedance changes allows for automatic output adjustment, resulting in stable and uniform results.

features.title: Wider Tip, Shorter Time
features.body: The tip has been widened by 16% compared to previous generations, reducing treatment time and discomfort during the procedure.

features.title: Vibration Pain Relief
features.body: The built-in vibration feature of the tip naturally disperses discomfort during the treatment.

thermage-flx.howItWorks: Monopolar RF energy is delivered simultaneously throughout the dermis, causing immediate collagen contraction, followed by the formation of new collagen over the next 6 months. You can expect elasticity changes that last for more than 6 months to a year with just one treatment.
recommendedFor: Those concerned about overall skin elasticity decline
Individuals wanting to improve fine lines and skin texture simultaneously
Those seeking smooth contours without surgery
Individuals who prefer a lifting treatment with minimal pain
Those wanting to care for both superficial and deep layers simultaneously with Ulthera

faq.q: How do Thermage and Ulthera differ?
faq.a: Ulthera uses ultrasound to target deeper layers like SMAS, while Thermage stimulates the entire dermis and surface with radiofrequency. Receiving both can provide synergistic effects at different depths, so we offer them as a package.
Thanks to the wider tip, treatments are typically completed within 30 to 50 minutes.

faq.q: How much pain can I expect?
faq.a: The cooling and vibration features of the tip help alleviate pain, making it tolerable for most patients, and additional numbing cream is not recommended.

faq.q: How long do the effects last?
faq.a: Collagen regeneration occurs over 6 months, and effects can last for 1 to 2 years or more (individual variations apply).

thermage-flx.introBody: Radiofrequency (RF) energy is delivered throughout the dermis to rearrange and strengthen collagen. The 4th generation Thermage FLX features a wider tip, faster treatment time, and automatic output adjustment (AccuREP) for improved safety and comfort compared to previous generations.

shurink-universe.name: Shurink Universe
shurink-universe.tagline: Precision tailored for each area with depth-specific cartridges
shurink-universe.intro:
Daily lifting that delivers HIFU energy
down to the SMAS layer, improving
firmness and lift at once

features.title: 1.5~13mm cartridges
features.body: Treatment can be customized for different depths using 5 types of cartridges (1.5/3.0/4.5/6.0/9.0/13mm) from the superficial layer to SMAS.

features.title: MMFU technology
features.body: Combining micro and macro-focused ultrasound targets both immediate contraction and long-term collagen regeneration.

features.title: Fast shot speed
features.body: Shortened intervals between shots reduce treatment time and minimize cumulative pain.

features.title: Wide area care
features.body: Treats various areas such as the entire face, neck, and double chin in a single session.

shurink-universe.howItWorks: High-intensity focused ultrasound energy forms coagulation points at the precise layer corresponding to the cartridge depth, and as these points heal naturally, new collagen fills in and lifts the skin. The 13mm cartridge stimulates the fat layer for contouring purposes.
recommendedFor: Those needing different depths for various areas
Those concerned about double chin and jawline
Those who are apprehensive about painful treatments
Those wanting to care for the entire face in one session
Those looking for a more affordable option than Ulthera

faq.q: How do Ulthera and Shurink differ?
faq.a: Both are HIFU, but Ulthera excels in video guidance and precise targeting of SMAS, while Shurink offers a wider variety of cartridges and faster treatment speeds. You can choose based on the area and skin condition or use them together.
Pain is alleviated with numbing cream, and the short shot intervals and precise output adjustments make it relatively tolerable.

faq.q: When can I expect to see results?
faq.a: Immediate effects can be felt right after treatment, but results will fully develop over 1 to 3 months as collagen regenerates.

faq.q: What is the recommended interval for re-treatment?
faq.a: Typically, 1 to 2 times a year is appropriate, and adjustments can be made after consulting with our medical staff based on skin condition and goals.

shurink-universe.introBody: Shurink uses High Intensity Focused Ultrasound to precisely stimulate the SMAS layer — the source of sagging — without damaging the skin surface, coagulating and contracting the tissue. Depending on the tip, it can also induce collagen regeneration, delivering energy accurately to deep layers to lift sagging skin naturally.

inmode.name: InMode
inmode.tagline: Simultaneous skin elasticity and contouring with RF
inmode.intro:
Contour lifting that delivers RF energy
to the skin and subcutaneous fat,
caring for firmness and contour together

features.title: Two handpieces
features.body: Forma is for larger areas, while Mini is for precise treatment of smaller areas. Using both handpieces in one session allows for simultaneous contouring and texture care.

features.title: Real-time temperature control
features.body: Monitors skin temperature in real-time and automatically adjusts RF output to maintain safety.

features.title: Minimal downtime
features.body: Aside from slight redness immediately after treatment, there is almost no trace left, allowing for a quick return to daily activities.

features.title: Repeat treatments possible
features.body: You can feel immediate elasticity after one session, and effects accumulate with 4-6 repeat treatments at 1-2 week intervals.

inmode.howItWorks: Monopolar/bipolar RF energy heats and contracts collagen in the dermis layer, creating immediate elasticity. With repeated treatments, collagen regeneration accumulates, gradually improving skin texture and contour. The procedure is performed without incisions or strong stimulation.
recommendedFor: Those concerned about fine lines and slight sagging
Those seeking a procedure with minimal downtime
Those who prefer repeated care over a single strong treatment
Those wanting to refine both facial contour and skin texture
Those without implants or metal (RF treatment is generally recommended)

faq.q: How is it different from Thermage?
faq.a: Thermage is a one-time package that provides strong stimulation, while InMode aims for gradual improvement through repeated treatments at 1-2 week intervals. It has less downtime and is generally more comfortable.

faq.q: How many sessions are needed to see results?
faq.a: You can feel elasticity after just one session, but 4-6 sessions at 1-2 week intervals are recommended. After that, maintenance treatments every 1-2 months are advised.
Most people find it comfortable, feeling like a warm massage, and it can be done without anesthetic cream.

faq.q: Is it effective for fat care as well?
faq.a: Separate InMode BodyTite/EvolveX lines are specialized for fat and cellulite, while Forma and Mini are primarily for elasticity and contour care.

inmode.introBody: Bipolar RF is delivered to the dermis and subcutaneous fat, inducing collagen synthesis in the dermis and apoptosis of fat cells. Forma delivers RF to the dermis for full-face firmness, while Mini-FX induces fat reduction to refine the contour. Used together, they address skin firmness and facial contour at the same time.

clarity-ii.name: Clarity II
clarity-ii.tagline: Nd:YAG + Alexandrite dual wavelength, from the epidermis to the deep dermis
clarity-ii.intro: A dual wavelength laser from Lutronic. It operates 1064nm Nd:YAG and 755nm Alexandrite in one device to address superficial pigmentation to stubborn pigment and vascular lesions deep within the dermis in a single treatment.

features.title: Nd:YAG (1064nm)
features.body: Reaches deep pigmentation and vascular lesions safely with its long wavelength.

features.title: Alexandrite (755nm)
features.body: Demonstrates strong absorption of melanin in the epidermis, effective for breaking down spots and pigmentation.

features.title: IntelliTrak system
features.body: Automatically recognizes handpiece speed to deliver uniform energy, reducing variability by the practitioner.

features.title: Multiple modes
features.body: Combines Q-switched, Long-pulsed, and Photothermolysis modes according to the type of pigmentation.

clarity-ii.howItWorks: The two wavelengths selectively absorb melanin (pigmentation) and hemoglobin (vascular) to generate photothermal effects. The Q-switched mode finely breaks down pigmentation, while the Long-pulsed mode reliably coagulates deep vascular lesions.
recommendedFor: Individuals with deep and complex pigmentation issues
Those wanting to address both epidermal and dermal pigmentation in one treatment
Individuals concerned about redness and vascular lesions
Those who have not seen sufficient results from previous toning treatments
Individuals seeking safe dual wavelength treatments

faq.q: How is it different from StarWalker?
faq.a: Clarity uses a dual wavelength, while StarWalker utilizes a multi-wavelength. Clarity balances superficial and deep pigmentation, whereas StarWalker excels in treating a wider range of pigmentation depths.
After applying a numbing cream, you may feel a slight sting. Any redness immediately after the treatment typically subsides within 1-2 days.
Depending on the type and depth of pigmentation, 3-10 sessions are usually recommended, typically spaced 3-4 weeks apart.

faq.q: What types of pigmentation are effective?
faq.a: Effectively addresses a wide range of issues including melasma, spots, freckles, seborrheic keratosis, stubborn pigmentation, and facial redness.

fotona-starwalker.name: Fotona StarWalker MAQX
fotona-starwalker.tagline: 4-wavelength multi-mode, precise toning by pigment depth
fotona-starwalker.intro: A multi-wavelength laser from Slovenia's Fotona. It allows for precise disintegration tailored to the type, depth, and color of pigments by freely combining four wavelengths: 1064nm, 532nm, 585nm, and 650nm, along with Q-switched and Long-pulsed modes.

features.title: 4-wavelength operation
features.body: Targets pigments optimally by using wavelengths of 1064 / 532 / 585 / 650nm based on type and depth.

features.title: VERSA pulse
features.body: Uses ultra-short pulse width to precisely disintegrate pigments while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissue.

features.title: TMD uniform beam
features.body: With Transverse Mode Discrimination technology, the beam distribution is uniform, ensuring consistent treatment results.

features.title: Premium Toning
features.body: Offers a premium toning mode that simultaneously cares for both epidermal and dermal pigments.

fotona-starwalker.howItWorks: Selects the most efficient wavelength for each type of pigment (melanin, hemoglobin) to induce photothermal absorption. The Q-Switched mode shatters pigments into tiny fragments in nanoseconds, while the Long-pulsed mode heats deeper layers stably for gradual disintegration.
recommendedFor: Those who want to address multiple pigments at once
Those who have not seen sufficient results from previous toning treatments
Individuals with stubborn pigments deep in the dermis
Those who want to brighten overall skin tone as well
Those seeking precise and safe treatments

faq.q: Which pigments are most effectively treated?
faq.a: Effectively addresses a wide range of stubborn pigments, including melasma, spots, freckles, seborrheic keratosis, and Ota and café-au-lait spots.
Topical anesthetic cream is applied. After treatment, mild redness subsides within 24 hours, allowing for a return to daily activities.
Typically 5-10 sessions at intervals of 3-4 weeks. The number of sessions is determined after consultation with our medical staff based on the type and depth of the pigment.

faq.q: Can those with sensitive skin undergo treatment?
faq.a: Yes, the VERSA pulse causes less irritation, but output will be adjusted through prior consultation.

vbeam.name: VBeam
vbeam.tagline: 595nm PDL vascular-specific laser, hemoglobin selective targeting
vbeam.intro: Candela's 595nm Pulsed Dye Laser. This vascular-specific laser selectively absorbs only hemoglobin, protecting normal tissue while soothing facial redness, telangiectasia, and post-acne PIE pigmentation.

features.title: 595nm wavelength
features.body: Precisely targets only abnormal blood vessels with optimal absorption for hemoglobin.

features.title: DCD cooling system
features.body: The Dynamic Cooling Device immediately cools the epidermis just before treatment, alleviating pain and irritation.

features.title: Multipulse mode
features.body: Safely and gradually treats small capillaries to larger vessels.

features.title: Non-invasive
features.body: Acts on dermal vessels without damaging the epidermis, resulting in minimal downtime.

vbeam.howItWorks: The 595nm wavelength selectively absorbs into hemoglobin, causing photothermal coagulation to close abnormal blood vessels. Adjacent normal tissue is protected by DCD cooling, ensuring both safety and rapid recovery.
recommendedFor: Individuals who are chronically concerned about facial redness and flushing
Those wanting to address telangiectasia (red spider veins)
Individuals with post-acne PIE redness
Those with chronic redness on the nose and cheeks
Individuals wishing to care for both pigmentation and redness

faq.q: When can I expect to see results?
faq.a: Immediate soothing effects are felt right after treatment, while permanent changes accumulate over multiple sessions.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: Depending on the area and severity, 3 to 5 sessions are recommended, spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart.

faq.q: What level of pain should I expect?
faq.a: A cool sensation with slight tingling due to DCD cooling. Anesthesia cream is not mandatory.
Moisturizing and sun protection are essential. It's advisable to avoid saunas and intense exercise for about a week.

secret-rf.name: Secret RF
secret-rf.tagline: Insulated microneedles + radiofrequency, dermal regeneration support
secret-rf.intro: Insulated microneedles penetrate the epidermis and release radiofrequency (RF) energy at precise depths in the dermis. This is a widely used supportive treatment for skin regeneration after pigmentation procedures, improving fine scars and pores, and refining skin texture.

features.title: Insulated coating needles
features.body: Releases energy precisely at the target depth in the dermis without causing damage while passing through the epidermis.

features.title: Fine depth adjustment
features.body: Allows for stepwise precise adjustments from 0.5 to 3.5mm, enabling treatments tailored to specific areas and purposes.

features.title: Bipolar RF
features.body: Energy is evenly distributed from both ends of the needle, enhancing consistency of results.

features.title: Combination care support
features.body: A representative supportive device that creates synergy when used in conjunction with pigmentation toning and scar treatments.

secret-rf.howItWorks: Insulated microneedles pass through the epidermis and release radiofrequency energy at the target depth in the dermis, inducing collagen and elastin regeneration. Newly formed dermal tissue gradually improves fine scars and pores.
recommendedFor: Those who want to actively promote skin regeneration after pigmentation procedures
Those concerned about fine scars and pores
Those who prefer combination care over single treatments
Those seeking gradual improvement in skin texture
Those who prefer treatments with short downtime

faq.q: How much pain can I expect?
faq.a: The procedure is performed after applying a numbing cream, and there may be slight prickling sensations depending on the area.
Mild redness and swelling may last for about 2-3 days, but you can return to daily activities immediately after the procedure.

faq.q: Can it be done alongside other treatments?
faq.a: It is not recommended to perform on the same day as toning; a gap of 1-2 weeks is safer.

faq.q: How long do the effects last?
faq.a: Effects accumulate over 3-6 months depending on collagen regeneration, and regular re-treatment is recommended.

carpri-co2.name: Carpri
carpri-co2.tagline: Fractional CO2 laser, the standard for reconstructing depressed scars and pores
carpri-co2.intro: The 10,600nm CO2 laser delivers precise micro-damage to the dermis in a fractional manner, inducing collagen regeneration. It is a representative device for gradually reconstructing depressed acne scars and enlarged pores.

features.title: Fractional Method
features.body: Delivers treatment in fine points to achieve rapid recovery and strong regenerative effects.

features.title: Customized Depth Adjustment
features.body: Adjusts penetration depth and density precisely according to the type of scar (ice pick, boxcar, rolling).

features.title: Collagen Regeneration
features.body: Normal tissue surrounding the micro-columns sends healing signals, allowing new collagen to fill in the scars.

features.title: Pore Reconstruction
features.body: The walls of enlarged pores contract, creating a smoother skin texture.

carpri-co2.howItWorks: The 10,600nm CO2 wavelength is absorbed by the skin's moisture, forming thermal damage in a micro-columnar shape. The surrounding undamaged tissue quickly sends healing signals, producing new collagen to fill in the scars and smooth the skin surface.
recommendedFor: Individuals with depressed acne scars (ice pick, boxcar, rolling)
Those concerned about enlarged pores
Individuals who want to see relatively strong effects quickly
Those who can tolerate a recovery period of 5 to 10 days
Individuals planning regular care for scar reconstruction

faq.a: There will be redness and scabbing for about 5 to 10 days, and makeup can be applied after 1 to 2 weeks.
Numbing cream is essential. There will be a tingling and warm sensation during the procedure.
Depending on the depth of the scars, 3 to 5 sessions are recommended at intervals of 1 to 2 months.

faq.q: I'm concerned about downtime; what are the alternatives?
faq.a: There are non-invasive alternatives such as Secret RF and Gold PTT, and options can be selected after consulting with our medical staff based on the type of scar.

mirajet-forte.name: Mirajet Forte
mirajet-forte.tagline: High-pressure sterilized saline spray for non-invasive pore cleansing
mirajet-forte.intro: Medical-grade high-pressure sterilized saline penetrates deeply into the pores to non-invasively cleanse sebum, dead skin cells, and impurities. It soothes trouble spots and provides immediate skin texture improvement, making it a regular care treatment that is easy to receive frequently.

features.title: Medical-grade sterilized saline
features.body: Uses highly pure cleansing solution with minimal skin irritation.

features.title: High-pressure fine spray
features.body: Gently washes away impurities deep within the pores with high-pressure spraying.

features.title: Immediate texture improvement
features.body: Skin texture becomes smooth immediately after treatment, enhancing makeup application.

features.title: 0 downtime
features.body: No epidermal damage allows for immediate return to daily activities after treatment.

mirajet-forte.howItWorks: The high-pressure fine saline spray reaches deep into the pores to gently cleanse sebum, dead skin cells, and impurities. At the same time, moisture is supplied to soothe the skin, resulting in immediate texture refinement.
recommendedFor: Those concerned about clogged pores and blackheads
Those who find downtime after treatment burdensome
Those seeking regular skin care
Those needing pore cleansing before acne treatment
Those wanting immediate results right before makeup application

faq.q: How long does the treatment take?
faq.a: It takes about 30-40 minutes, making it a quick procedure.
There is only a cool spraying sensation, with minimal pain.
It is fine to receive regular care once or twice a month without burden.

faq.q: Can it be done with other treatments?
faq.a: Performing pore cleansing before treatments like toning or RF can enhance absorption and effectiveness.

inmode-morpheus.name: InMode Morpheus
inmode-morpheus.intro: InMode Morpheus8 combines microneedles with RF energy to deliver deep dermal heating, rebuilding acne scars, pores, and skin texture.

features.title: Scar & pore rebuild
features.body: Micro-columns treat pitted acne scars and enlarged pores.

features.title: Adjustable depth
features.body: Needle depth tuned to zone and goal for precise treatment.

features.title: Collagen remodeling
features.body: Deep dermal heat drives new collagen formation.

features.title: Short downtime
features.body: Mild redness immediately after; rapid return to daily life.

inmode-morpheus.howItWorks: Fine needles enter the skin and emit RF energy at their tips, minimizing epidermal damage while triggering coagulation in the deeper dermis.
recommendedFor: Acne scars
Enlarged pores
Skin texture · resurfacing
Hypertrophic scars

faq.a: Topical anesthetic is applied; most patients tolerate it well.
Typically 3–4 sessions at 3–4 week intervals.

markview-co2.name: CO2
markview-co2.tagline: Fractional CO2 laser for scars, pigmentation and pores
markview-co2.intro: MarkView CO2 is a fractional carbon-dioxide laser that precisely resurfaces scars, pores, and pigmented lesions. Micro-columns trigger dermal collagen renewal.

features.title: Scar & pore rebuild
features.body: Precise micro-columns treat pitted scars and enlarged pores.

features.title: Pigmented lesion removal
features.body: Safely removes age spots, milia and warts on the surface.

features.title: Depth & density control
features.body: Fine-tune depth and scan density for each zone.

features.title: Collagen remodeling
features.body: Deep dermal stimulation drives new collagen for lasting results.

markview-co2.howItWorks: 10600nm CO₂ laser is absorbed by water molecules, creating micro-columns that trigger surrounding tissue's natural healing response.
recommendedFor: Acne scars
Enlarged pores
Age spots · milia · warts
Skin texture refinement

faq.a: Depending on zone and intensity, typically 3–7 days of recovery.
Topical anesthetic is applied; you may feel warmth during treatment.

aqua-peel.name: Aqua Peel
aqua-peel.tagline: 3-step hydro peel for a smooth, luminous glow
aqua-peel.intro: Aqua Peel is a three-step hydro-peeling system combining mild acidic solutions with water jets. It gently removes dead skin and impurities while infusing soothing and hydrating ampoules for an immediate glow.

features.title: Three-step program
features.body: S1 exfoliation · S2 deep cleansing · S3 soothing hydration in sequence.

features.title: Gentle exfoliation
features.body: Micro water-jet + mild solution lifts dead skin and sebum without irritation.

features.title: Instant radiance
features.body: Clears impurities so skin looks smoother and brighter right after treatment.

features.title: Zero downtime
features.body: Cleanse and apply makeup immediately — ideal for pre-event care.

aqua-peel.howItWorks: S1 prep ampoule → S2 deep cleansing ampoule → S3 soothing ampoule are sprayed sequentially while the water jet gently removes debris and delivers active ingredients.
recommendedFor: Dull skin tone
Congested pores
Rough texture · thick dead skin
Immediate glow before events

faq.a: Every 2–4 weeks for maintenance is recommended.
Low-irritation; intensity is adjusted per consultation.

ldm.name: LDM (Local Dynamic Micromassage)
ldm.intro: LDM by Wellcomet uses two ultrasound frequencies alternating hundreds of times per second, delivering a micro-massage effect at the cellular level to calm and restore compromised skin.

features.title: Barrier restoration
features.body: Dual-frequency ultrasound calms the barrier and boosts hydration retention.

features.title: Post-laser recovery
features.body: Rapidly reduces redness and heat after lasers or peels.

features.title: Inflammation calming
features.body: Gently treats post-acne inflammation and sensitized skin.

features.title: No pain · no downtime
features.body: Minimal stimulation — return to daily life immediately.

ldm.howItWorks: Two frequencies (3MHz · 10MHz) alternate rapidly, inducing cellular vibration that boosts interstitial fluid circulation and cell regeneration signals.
recommendedFor: Post-laser/peel recovery
Sensitive · redness-prone skin
Post-acne inflammation
Compromised skin barrier

faq.a: Weekly or bi-weekly sessions work best.
Facial use is generally safe; consultation confirms suitability.

bellalux.name: BellaLux LED
bellalux.intro: BellaLux delivers medical-grade LED light in multiple wavelengths — red, blue, and near-infrared — for targeted acne, calming, healing, and redness care.

features.title: Acne bacteria control
features.body: 415nm blue light selectively suppresses P. acnes.

features.title: Calming · redness care
features.body: 630nm red light soothes inflammation and reduces redness.

features.title: Regeneration
features.body: 830nm NIR reaches deep dermis for cellular renewal.

features.title: Painless
features.body: No heat or discomfort during treatment.

bellalux.howItWorks: Multi-wavelength LEDs trigger photobiological responses in the epidermis and dermis, activating cellular processes specific to each wavelength.
recommendedFor: Inflammatory acne
Post-laser/peel recovery
Redness · sensitive skin
Collagen renewal

faq.a: No pain or discomfort — very relaxing.
Works well alone and accelerates recovery when combined with other treatments.

juvederm.name: Juvéderm VOLIFT
juvederm.tagline: Natural volume & wrinkle correction with HA filler
juvederm.intro: Juvéderm VOLIFT is a hyaluronic-acid filler from Allergan (USA) using patented VYCROSS technology to create smooth, natural-looking volume — refining nasolabial folds, cheeks and lip corners.

features.title: Smooth volume
features.body: VYCROSS integrates naturally with tissue for supple volume.

features.title: Long lasting
features.body: Averages 12–15 months, reducing touch-up frequency.

features.title: Comfort
features.body: Contains lidocaine to minimize procedure discomfort.

features.title: Precise contouring
features.body: Refines facial lines around nose, mouth, and cheeks.

juvederm.howItWorks: Injected into the dermis with fine needles or cannulas, HA particles settle into tissue and support volume naturally.
recommendedFor: Nasolabial folds
Cheek volume loss
Those seeking natural results
Longer-lasting filler

faq.a: Lidocaine included minimizes discomfort during treatment.
Typically resolves in 2–5 days.

belotero.name: Belotero
belotero.tagline: CPM-formulated HA filler line that integrates smoothly
belotero.intro: Belotero from Merz (Germany) uses patented CPM (Cohesive Polydensified Matrix) technology to blend seamlessly with tissue while preserving natural expression. Available in Soft · Balance · Intense · Volume for zone-specific customization.

features.title: Natural expression
features.body: CPM blends into tissue and moves with your face.

features.title: Zone-specific
features.body: Choose from 4 formulas for tear troughs, folds, lips, or volume.

features.title: Smooth finish
features.body: Even spread with no lumping for a smooth surface.

features.title: Comfort
features.body: Contains lidocaine to minimize discomfort.

belotero.howItWorks: CPM-formulated HA gels with layered density integrate uniformly, supporting volume, texture, and expression.
recommendedFor: Tear troughs
Nasolabial folds
Lip volume
Those wanting natural expression

faq.q: Which line is right for me?
faq.a: We decide together based on zone and desired result.
6–12 months depending on line and area.

rejuran.name: Rejuran
rejuran.tagline: Salmon DNA (PDRN·PN) for dermal regeneration and smoother skin texture
rejuran.intro:
A signature skin booster that uses PN
to restore the skin's regenerative environment,
calm inflammation, and stimulate collagen

features.title: Dermal regeneration
features.body: PN stimulates the skin's own repair of damaged tissue.

features.title: Texture & elasticity
features.body: Fine lines, pores, and firmness improve together.

features.title: Skin barrier
features.body: Helps restore the barrier of sensitive, dry skin.

features.title: Natural finish
features.body: Improves texture and tone rather than adding volume.

rejuran.howItWorks: Micro-injected into the upper dermis → PN signals tissue regeneration → collagen and elastin are rebuilt.

Early loss of elasticity
Sensitive, dry skin
Recovery after laser

faq.a: We apply lidocaine numbing cream first; the procedure itself takes 5–10 minutes.
Tiny bumps or redness may appear on the day and usually settle within a day.

rejuran.introBody: A regenerative skin booster that injects PN (polynucleotide) into the dermis to restore a damaged skin environment and stimulate collagen production and ECM recovery. By reactivating the skin's own regenerative capacity, it improves elasticity and texture with an anti-aging effect.

rejuran-i.name: Rejuran I
rejuran-i.tagline: Eye-area PN skin booster for fine lines and dark circles
rejuran-i.intro: Rejuran I is a low-concentration PN formula made for the eye area, gently improving fine lines, elasticity, and dark circles on thin, delicate skin.

features.title: Made for the eye area
features.body: A gentle formula designed for thin under-eye skin.

features.title: Fine lines
features.body: Smooths crow's feet and fine creases around the eyes.

features.title: Dark circles
features.body: Better circulation and texture brighten dark tones.

features.title: Quick recovery
features.body: Short downtime, so you can return to your day quickly.

rejuran-i.howItWorks: Micro-injected into the dermis under the eyes and at the corners → PN stimulates collagen around the eye area.
recommendedFor: Fine lines around the eyes
Under-eye dark circles
Loss of firmness around the eyes
Delicate eye-area skin

features.title: Immediate volume
features.body: The soluble gel carrier (CMC) creates instant volume right after treatment.

features.title: Collagen seeds

ellanse.howItWorks: Ellansé's secret is the synergy of two key ingredients in a perfect ratio (CMC 70% + PCL 30%). CMC (a soluble gel carrier) completes immediate volume right after treatment, while PCL (polymer microspheres) stimulates collagen so your own tissue fills in naturally over time.
recommendedFor: Those who dislike the artificial volume, show-through, or migration of fillers
Those who want overall skin firmness, beyond just filling sunken areas
Those who want a natural feel with no foreign-body sensation
Those seeking a long, stable duration of a year or more instead of quickly absorbed treatments
Those whose facial lines have softened and want refined, dimensional contouring

faq.q: What's the biggest difference from regular hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers?
faq.a: Ellansé prompts your own skin to produce real collagen. Over time it fills in with your own tissue, looking far more natural.

faq.q: Is it safe if the ingredient stays in the body?
faq.a: Both PCL and CMC are US FDA and European CE certified medical materials; after the designated duration they safely biodegrade and leave the body.

faq.q: How is the pain? Will it affect daily life?
faq.a: Performed gently under local anesthesia. Slight swelling, stiffness, or minor bruising may follow but usually settles within a few days.

faq.q: When do results appear and how long do they last?
faq.a: Immediate volume improvement is visible right after treatment, and from about a month later your own collagen builds for an even more natural look. Duration is about 1 year, often 2 years or more.

ellanse.introBody: A combination of polycaprolactone (PCL) and CMC gel: the CMC gel creates natural early volume and lift, while PCL stimulates fibroblasts to synthesize collagen. Collagen volume lifting that helps restore natural volume and elasticity.
